notes: «وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ» stands for prev1's chain up to Sa'd («أَبِی ره قَالَ حَدَّثَنِی سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ»): those two names are taken as inherited and the back-reference is not also written.
«أخيه عبد الله» is one link (rule 7). The Imam speaks inside the narrated encounter («فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ»), so he is the last link.
